items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: And we played, we both played with my father's band.

ctx.x: You can just give your name then. My name is Rick Carter Lexus. I was born in New Orleans, Louisiana in 1896. You have the exact date? On the 16th date of October. And my mother and father moved from New Orleans and moved over to Basin Lewis, which my father was a professor of violin player, taught music. You can just sit back and relax. It'll pick up anything. And I went to school in Basin Lewis. When did you move over there? You moved either barn here, but then moved over. My father and mother moved over. I was…
So I was asking about the brass bands over...
